name: com.midmanstudio.audio
description: Audio for Unity 2022.3+: music manager with crossfade and pitch glide, SFX playback by library id or generated enum, audio categories with a mixer group and volume, a pooled-voice clip player, pooled spatial audio objects, a peak limiter for the final mix (Rust DSP on desktop and mobile, C# fallback on WebGL), and a relay that plays audio for GlobalFXManager effects.
